title: DebiasRAG: A Tuning-Free Path to Fair Generation in Large Language Models through Retrieval-Augmented Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using cloze tests to compare the probabilities assigned to gender-stereotyped versus anti-stereotyped text (StereoSet-gender), sentence-level probability comparisons (CrowS-Pairs), and word embedding association tests measuring the link between male/female terms and career/family attributes (SEAT tests 6, 6b, 7, 7b, 8, 8b).
Evaluated as part of the broader bias benchmarks and noted by the authors as being captured through SEAT and CrowS-Pairs stereotype testing.

Evaluated across multiple demographic categories using overall language modeling and stereotype scores via cloze tests (StereoSet-overall) and by measuring whether the language model assigns higher probabilities to historically stereotyped sentences compared to anti-stereotyped counterparts (CrowS-Pairs).
